Absolutely — here are a few low-friction vegetarian dinners for the week:

- Chili crisp peanut noodles + cucumber + tofu
- Sheet-pan gnocchi with broccoli, white beans, and feta
- Lentil coconut curry over rice
- Black bean quesadillas with sautéed peppers + salsa
- Miso butter mushrooms on rice with a jammy egg or tofu
- One-pot tomato chickpea pasta

If you want, I can turn this into a 5-night plan with a grocery list and keep it very newborn-friendly.
